hypotheses.statement: ClayCode can preserve broad host-effect expressibility without stale async authority if runtime resources are represented by opaque generation-bound handles with explicit own/borrow state and current authority is revalidated at effect time.
hypotheses.support: 100000-case executable proxy produced zero oracle mismatches under revoke/regrant/transfer/wrong-right events when current generation/liveness/right were checked at effect time.
hypotheses.falsifier: A production or target-host case where this model either accepts stale authority or cannot express a required ordinary application effect without an escape hatch.

hypotheses.statement: Raw OS handle numbers must not serve as durable Clay semantic resource identity or bearer authority across the FFI boundary.
hypotheses.support: In a direct Linux fixture, closed fd 3 was immediately reused for a different file and a stale write through integer 3 mutated the new file.
hypotheses.falsifier: A complete runtime design proving that raw-handle reuse cannot redirect a stale Clay authority across all supported FFI/resource paths.

hypotheses.statement: Static transitive effect summaries should remain requirement metadata; they must not become runtime bearer authority, including after await/re-entry/retry.
hypotheses.support: Current spawn proxy plus preceding ClayCode effect-closure runs separate static requirements from current runtime grants.
hypotheses.falsifier: A simpler authority construction using effect metadata alone that remains sound under revocation, regrant, transfer, forged handles and host-resource reuse.

hypotheses.statement: The lowest-complexity safe async borrowing policy is not yet decided: conservative no-borrow-across-suspension and runtime borrow tracking with effect-time revalidation are competing implementations.
hypotheses.support: Both policy families can preserve the observed safety boundary in principle; this run did not benchmark utility/latency/repair cost.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production application evidence clearly dominates one policy on safety plus utility/cost.

counterhypotheses.statement: A capability snapshot checked once at task start is sufficient authority for a later effect.
counterhypotheses.result: Rejected in the executable proxy: 79982/100000 total unauthorized delayed effects were falsely accepted by the cached-snapshot comparator, including 59747 stale-authority cases caused specifically by revoke/regrant/transfer.

counterhypotheses.statement: A raw integer Linux file descriptor is a stable semantic resource identity across close/reopen.
counterhypotheses.result: Directly false in the tested Linux fixture: fd 3 was reused and a stale integer write affected the newly opened file.

counterhypotheses.statement: Duplicating/reusing an old owner token after ownership transfer is safe.
counterhypotheses.result: 0/20000 double-transfer attempts were accepted in the affine proxy; stale borrows after transfer also had 0 accepts.
